_comment: NH municipality roster for the nh-elections project. The towns object is keyed by the 2020 Census county subdivision GEOID (STATE+COUNTY+COUSUB, 10 digits). That identifier is stable across the current geography files in nh-elections-data and is repeated as census_cousub_geoid on each entry. name is the spelling published on the 2026 Secretary of State ballot-types-by-town lists (including typographic apostrophes). aliases lists GRANIT, Census, and SOS voting-districts spellings when they differ from name. kind is town, city, or unincorporated place: city when the 2020 Census NAMELSAD ends in 'city'; unincorporated place when the SOS towns-and-wards list puts the unit under the heading 'Unincorporated Places', or when the Census NAMELSAD class is grant, purchase, location, or township; town otherwise. Two disagreements are left visible: Livermore is an SOS Unincorporated Place whose Census NAMELSAD is 'Livermore town' (kind follows the SOS heading); Dixville and Millsfield are Census townships classified here as unincorporated place, though the SOS list does not place them under 'Unincorporated Places'. Berlin is a city listed without wards. ballot_type and electronic_poll_book are keyed by election year so later years can be added. districts is keyed by the redistricting plan year (2022 for the 2022–2032 plans). House assignments include the base district and, when present, the floterial. For the 12 cities the SOS lists with wards, district assignments are on each ward, not on the city entry. Eleven Coos unincorporated places are abbreviated on the SOS voting-districts list; their GRANIT town IDs and Census GEOIDs are applied from the documented one-for-one matches in raw/sos-voting-districts/derived/name_mismatches.csv, and the abbreviated SOS spelling is stored as an alias. vote_in is the host town published on the 2026 ballot-type lists for unincorporated places that vote in another municipality. Dates in source_updated are converted to ISO YYYY-MM-DD from the list-page 'Updated:' wording. Paths under source point at files in nh-elections-data.

sources.name: NH Secretary of State, Ballot Types by Town (2026 index and four official lists)
NH Secretary of State, Electronic Poll Books (2026)
NH Secretary of State, Voting Districts (2022–2032 plans) and derived town/ward crosswalk
GRANIT / NH Office of Planning and Development, Political Districts (Voting Wards) 2022, joined in the SOS voting-districts crosswalk
U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 P.L. 94-171 name look-up tables (NAMES_ST33_NH), county subdivision GEOIDs joined in the SOS voting-districts crosswalk
